'''Gaar''' was a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Gaar worked as a barman in the [[Tolea Biqua]] [[Vanster Enan's Cantina (Tolea Biqua franchise)|franchise]] of [[Vanster Enan's Sop House]]. He was present there during the [[SoroSuub Anniversary celebration, 31 BBY|SoroSuub Anniversary celebration]] in [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]].

By the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Gaar had became a member of the [[Believers]], a [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]] that operated in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. When the [[Heroes of Cularin]] discovered something in the [[Cularin asteroid belt|asteroid belt]] that could be used to destroy the [[Darkstaff]], [[Len Markus]], the leader of the Believers, sent Gaar, [[Ulis]], and some other Believers to travel there and stop the heroes.
